ui.providers-schedule.a-command-is-requi: A command is required and can’t contain line breaks or other control characters
ui.providers-schedule.a-name-is-required: A name is required, up to 60 characters
ui.providers-schedule.absolute-path-of-t: Absolute path of the executable, or a name on PATH
ui.providers-schedule.an-external-cli-ru: An external CLI runs on your computer as you, so only add programs you trust. Nomi asks you before every tool call (Ask each time).
ui.providers-schedule.argument-uses-the-: Argument {0} uses the unknown placeholder {1} (only {2} are allowed)
ui.providers-schedule.at-most-32-argumen: At most 32 arguments, each up to 512 characters, with no line breaks
ui.providers-schedule.claude-code-codex-: Coding agent CLIs on this machine, plus coding assistant tabs in Nomi.
ui.providers-schedule.connect-any-coding: Connect any coding assistant that speaks ACP (Agent Client Protocol). Only the command, arguments and environment variable names are saved; no third-party code is loaded.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-app-git: Repos, issues, PRs and CI; reuse your gh login or paste a token
ui.providers-schedule.connection-app-mcp: Mail, calendar and more: set them up in Extensions, then grant tools per task
ui.providers-schedule.connection-duplica: This account is already connected: {0}. Replace it (task grants keep working), or keep both (give this one a name)?
ui.providers-schedule.connection-gh-acco: Local gh is logged in as {0} (scopes: {1})
ui.providers-schedule.connection-gh-logg: gh isn't logged in to {0}: run gh auth login in a terminal, then come back.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-gh-miss: gh (GitHub CLI) is not installed. Install and log in, or paste a token.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-gh-othe: gh also has {0}, but gh uses one account at a time; to use it too, paste a token for it.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-gh-swit: gh is now using {0}, not {1} as this connection expects.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-host-hi: Using GitHub Enterprise? Enter its host; each host connects separately.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-rebind-: Switch to {0}? Tasks that use this connection will pause until you grant them again.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-remove-: Remove the connection “{0}”? Tasks that use it will stop and ask you to authorize them again.
ui.providers-schedule.connection-token-h: To watch specific repos, a read-only fine-grained token is enough. GitHub notifications only work with classic tokens (with the notifications scope).
ui.providers-schedule.connection-wide-sc: This login can do much more than read: {0}. What tasks may do is set by their authorization; to read only, use a read-only fine-grained token instead.
ui.providers-schedule.connections-help-g: Reuse the local gh login or paste a token. Tasks read only what they are authorized to; other repos are refused.
ui.providers-schedule.connections-help-s: A login may carry wide scopes; what each task may do is set by its own authorization, and credentials never reach the model.
ui.providers-schedule.connections-intro: Apps and accounts Nomi can use: credentials stay where they are, and tasks only read or act within what you've granted.
ui.providers-schedule.couldn-t-detect-it: Couldn't detect it; restart Nomi and try again
ui.providers-schedule.default-account-ch: Default account changed to {0}; tabs that follow the default switch on their next message
ui.providers-schedule.delete-the-externa: Delete the external CLI “{0}”? Tabs that use it stay, but they can’t send messages anymore.
ui.providers-schedule.each-account-has-i: Each account has its own configuration folder and {0} handles sign-in itself; Nomi doesn’t store sign-in credentials. Different tabs can use different accounts at the same time; the default account is used by new tabs and tabs that follow the default.
ui.providers-schedule.generated-with-the: Generated with the current chat model when due; results go to the chat window, and the mascot's bubble lets you know (the Dynamic Island or a system notification while the mascot is closed). Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to save
ui.providers-schedule.have-nomi-give-you: Have Nomi give you a briefing every morning, or remind you to write your weekly report every Friday.
ui.providers-schedule.lowercase-letters-: Lowercase letters, digits and - only; after saving it identifies the tabs and conversations
ui.providers-schedule.manage-versions-an: Install an assistant, then pick a model. Versions and official accounts are here.
ui.providers-schedule.names-only-such-as: Names only (such as MY_TOKEN). Values are inherited from the environment Nomi was started in, and Nomi doesn’t store them.
ui.providers-schedule.new-tab-source-hin: Which account or third-party provider new {0} tabs use by default; each tab can still switch.
ui.providers-schedule.notification-style: Notification style and types are set in Notifications / Dynamic Island; quiet hours are set in Schedule.
ui.providers-schedule.one-per-line-you-c: One per line; you can use {0} (working folder) and {1} (home folder). No shell is involved, so variables and wildcards are not expanded.
ui.providers-schedule.only-sessions-whos: Only sessions whose files were just written and whose process is still running count, de-duplicated per session. Reads local logs and the process list only — never signs in or scrapes any account.
ui.providers-schedule.pick-the-coding-as: Install status is on the left. Runtime and permissions sit under General, folded by default.
ui.providers-schedule.ran-the-result-was: “{0}” ran; the result was sent to the chat window
ui.providers-schedule.read-task-status-a: Read task status and periodic summaries aloud in addition to the chime; when off, only the chime plays. Respects the voice switch and mute.
ui.providers-schedule.ready-to-chat-she-: Ready to chat; she'll speak up at random while you're idle
ui.providers-schedule.reminders-due-duri: Reminders due during do-not-disturb are held and delivered together afterwards; scheduled tasks still run, with results only written to the chat window. Spanning midnight is supported (e.g. 22:30 – 08:00).
ui.providers-schedule.remove-the-account: Remove the account “{0}”? {1} will be signed out in this account’s folder (revoking the sign-in) and the folder will be deleted. Conversation history is kept.
ui.providers-schedule.requests-go-throug: Requests go through the Nomi gateway, which converts protocols. Each {0} tab can pick the official account or a third party from the top-right of the chat, independently, without changing the CLI global config.
ui.providers-schedule.runtime-problem-no: Node.js or npm on this computer has a problem, so installing or updating coding assistants may fail.
ui.providers-schedule.show-a-bubble-dyna: Show a bubble / Dynamic Island notice when a task finishes, fails, stalls or waits for confirmation.
ui.providers-schedule.sign-in-happens-in: Sign-in happens in this account’s own configuration folder through {0}’s official flow. Nomi doesn’t store sign-in credentials, and other accounts aren’t affected.
ui.providers-schedule.sign-in-to-it-in-a: Sign in to it in a terminal first ({0}).
ui.providers-schedule.signed-in-as-you-c: Signed in as {0}. You can make it the default account, or pick it for a single tab.
ui.providers-schedule.task-action-reject: This action is not available right now ({0})
ui.providers-schedule.task-applied: Copied back {0} files; {1} conflicts, {2} outside the grant
ui.providers-schedule.task-apply-worktre: Land the worktree changes in {0}? Small changes are copied back to the workspace; large changes, conflicts and files outside the grant are committed to a new nomi/… branch. The worktree is cleaned up afterwards.
ui.providers-schedule.task-cancel-confir: Cancel this task? Any run in progress stops; results so far are kept.
ui.providers-schedule.task-card-expiry: Expires in {0} days; you can renew it before then
ui.providers-schedule.task-card-no-folde: Allowed folders: none (no local file access)
ui.providers-schedule.task-event-feed: It is an RSS / Atom feed
ui.providers-schedule.task-event-observe: New event tasks only record what they find; turn on automatic handling in the task details.
ui.providers-schedule.task-executor-cli-: Works in a separate git worktree; changes reach your workspace only after you accept them
ui.providers-schedule.task-feedback-plac: Say what to change if you send it back
ui.providers-schedule.task-folders-hint: File access is limited to these folders; add none to keep local files off-limits
ui.providers-schedule.task-gh-actions-no: Fill in the repos above. Each outside action is logged before it runs; if a restart leaves it unclear whether it went out, Nomi checks first and asks you only when it can't tell.
ui.providers-schedule.task-gh-pr: Open PRs from nomi/ branches (never merges)
ui.providers-schedule.task-github-repos-: One owner/repo per line; leave empty to keep GitHub out of it
ui.providers-schedule.task-goal-placehol: e.g. Check the CI of repo X every morning and tell me why if it fails
ui.providers-schedule.task-level-1: Read only: files, web pages and local records
ui.providers-schedule.task-level-2: Local writes: knowledge base, memory, files in authorized folders
ui.providers-schedule.task-mcp-empty: No local MCP server is connected yet (Settings → Extensions)
ui.providers-schedule.task-mcp-readonly-: Only tools marked read-only can be picked; called at most every 5 minutes. Each new item in the result counts as one event.
ui.providers-schedule.task-mcp-tools: MCP tools it may use (local servers only)
ui.providers-schedule.task-mode-act-conf: Run this task automatically whenever something new is found (within its grant)?
ui.providers-schedule.task-reconcile-hin: The app closed while this task was taking an outside action. Check whether it went through, then choose how to continue.
ui.providers-schedule.task-regrant-confi: Authorize again with the same scope ({0})?
ui.providers-schedule.task-remove-confir: Delete this task and its run history?
ui.providers-schedule.task-revoke-confir: Revoke this task’s authorization? Any run in progress stops, and it needs a new authorization to continue.
ui.providers-schedule.task-section-who: Who does it and what it may use
ui.providers-schedule.task-source-mcp: New results from an MCP tool
ui.providers-schedule.task-taken-over: You took over; tell me when it is done
ui.providers-schedule.task-tool-web: Look things up on the web
ui.providers-schedule.tasks-empty: No tasks yet. Tell Nomi “every day at 9, please…” in a chat, or click New task.
ui.providers-schedule.tasks-hint: Tell Nomi once and it keeps track: it runs on schedule and comes to you when it needs you.
ui.providers-schedule.the-id-can-only-us: The id can only use lowercase letters, digits and -, up to 40 characters
ui.providers-schedule.the-main-process-w: The main-process watcher isn't reachable in this environment.
ui.providers-schedule.this-id-is-already: This id is already used by a built-in coding assistant
ui.providers-schedule.this-identity-is-a: This identity is also signed in under “{0}”. When the same account refreshes its sign-in in two places, one of them stops working, so keep only one.
ui.providers-schedule.what-should-the-as: What should the assistant do? e.g. Summarize today's reminders and give me a word of encouragement
ui.providers-schedule.when-on-nomi-occas: When on, Nomi occasionally starts a chat while you're idle (using topics from long-term memory). Off by default; never during do-not-disturb hours, right after you've chatted, or while you're away.
ui.providers-schedule.write-environment-: Write environment variable names only (such as MY_TOKEN), not values
ui.providers-schedule.task-sandbox-pregr: Allow in the coding-agent sandbox up front (no prompts while running; SSH and Git credentials are added automatically for GitHub actions)
